label: Shopify
description: Orders, products, stock, customers of a store
agentGuide: Admin REST API; paths end with .json. Shop: GET /shop.json. Orders: GET /orders.json?status=open&limit=20&fields=id,name,created_at,total_price,financial_status,fulfillment_status,customer (also status=any, financial_status=unpaid, created_at_min=<ISO>); one: GET /orders/<id>.json; fulfil: GET /orders/<id>/fulfillment_orders.json then POST /fulfillments.json {"fulfillment": {"line_items_by_fulfillment_order": [{"fulfillment_order_id": ...}], "tracking_info": {"number": "..."}}}; cancel: POST /orders/<id>/cancel.json; refund: POST /orders/<id>/refunds.json (calculate first with POST /orders/<id>/refunds/calculate.json). Products: GET /products.json?limit=20&title=<words>; one: GET /products/<id>.json (variants[] with inventory_item_id); stock: GET /inventory_levels.json?inventory_item_ids=<id>, set: POST /inventory_levels/set.json {"location_id": ..., "inventory_item_id": ..., "available": 12}; create: POST /products.json {"product": {"title": "...", "variants": [{"price": "9.90"}]}}. Customers: GET /customers/search.json?query=email:<email>; count: GET /orders/count.json?status=any. Pagination: the Link header (page_info). The token is set by Allkin.
